identitySignals: The agenda name matches the public agency Peralta Community College District, whose own site says it serves northern Alameda County.
The agenda lists San Leandro, CA. That matches East Bay Innovations (a nonprofit at 2450 Washington Ave, San Leandro), not Peralta, whose district office is in Oakland.
I found no page linking Peralta and East Bay Innovations in an early childhood education partnership.
research.notes: Identity is ambiguous, so this should not be published. The agenda entry reads 'Peralta Community College District (for East Bay Innovations)' with a San Leandro location. The MOU may be with Peralta, with East Bay Innovations (EBI), or with both. EBI is a San Leandro nonprofit (EIN 94-3210351 per Charity Navigator and TaxExemptWorld search results), but I did not fetch or cite those pages. The profile above describes Peralta only, based on the literal vendor name, and it conflicts with the San Leandro location. A reviewer should decide which entity is the vendor. I did not look up the registry IDs for either entity.

profile.summary: Founded in 1964, the Peralta Community College District is a public community college district in northern Alameda County, California. It includes four colleges: Berkeley City College, College of Alameda, Laney College and Merritt College.
